players.product: burn-in and final-test sockets for AI GPUs / ASICs

quarterly_data.signal: CPO technology forum deck (May 14, 2026): WinWay offers CPO and co-packaged copper (CPC) test solutions across wafer level (WLCSP fine-pitch probe heads for EIC / PIC wafer test), package level (optical and electrical test sockets for optical engines, a double-sided probing system) and module level (HyperSocket); the company says HyperSocket gives about 30% lower and more stable contact resistance, about 30% higher current-carrying capacity and about 30% less joule heat than spring-probe sockets for packages over 100 x 100 mm2 with more than 10,000 pins, and that an extremely-high-power version above 2500W is under validation.
quarterly_data.figure: about 30% lower contact resistance; >2500W version under validation
